title: The Log Is the Agent
summary: This paper proposes a novel architectural pattern where system logs serve as the primary abstraction for AI agent behavior and coordination, treating logging infrastructure as the core agentic layer rather than a secondary concern.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of creating reliable, auditable, and persistent AI agent systems with better observability and state management.
why_valuable: Provides a fundamentally different approach to building AI agents that improves debuggability, auditability, and system reliability without sacrificing autonomy.
